name: The Eyes
source:
Our main character lives in another world, where everyone has green eyes with the ability to foresee the future in 15 seconds. There are persons with special qualities possessing new abilities and changing their eye colors. But unlike everyone, he doesn't have any abilities. So why he suddenly be targeted by ones with heterochromia?

[Translated from the [url=https://g18vn.com/the-eyes/]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公生活在另一个世界，那里的人都有绿色的眼睛，能够预见15秒后的未来。一些具有特殊资质的人，还会获得新的能力，眼睛的颜色也随之改变。然而，与所有人不同，他没有任何能力。那么，他为何会突然被拥有异色瞳的人盯上？

[译自[url=https://g18vn.com/the-eyes/]官方网站[/url]]
